winget.supportedSystems: Windows 11 and Windows Server 2025 with Desktop Experience. Windows Server 2022 and earlier are not supported by WinGet.

legacyBootstrap.reason: The supported App Installer matrix excludes Windows 10, so startup must not bootstrap WinGet on the legacy Windows 10 path.

nonWindowsCli.platformScope: Keep the OS and package-manager filters in platform-detect.ps1 unchanged.

recovery.windows: Use a Windows 11 Home or Pro x64 client release listed here and still within its end-of-servicing date. If none are both current and listed, update Windows and use an App Installer release with a refreshed compatibility contract.
recovery.engine: Use Windows PowerShell 5.1 on a supported Windows host or install PowerShell Core 7.6.7 only while its published support lifecycle remains active. If the pinned version has reached end of support, use an App Installer release with a current compatibility contract.
recovery.gui: Use the CLI entry point when Windows Forms or the required desktop runtime is unavailable.
